headline: Oil Rises 2.07 Percent To $101.97 While Precious Metals Slip
narrative: Crude oil rose 2.07 percent to $101.97, with money moving into the energy pipe. Silver fell 0.76 percent to $53.88 and gold eased 0.4 percent to $4,058.40, so money left the precious-metals pipe. Copper rose 0.71 percent to $6.67, an industrial bid that moved with oil rather than with silver and gold.
author: jordan
